name: Unexpected Opportunity
source:
Following a fairly uneventful year after high school, you are hounded by your parents to move out. However, after taking that leap of faith and moving to a new city, you don’t exactly manage your situation very well at all. Now looking at the prospect of being evicted from your apartment, you need to knuckle down and get to work.

Maybe you’ll meet an angel that will guide you on the right path?

Maybe you’ll meet a new friend to pick you up when times are hard.

Maybe you can even meet an old crush from your past and maybe, JUST maybe, you’re mature enough to handle it this time...

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/sweetychily/about]Patreon[/url]]
